title: ailanthus glandulosa f. rubra
intro: Ailanthus glandulosa f. rubra, commonly known as Red Chinese Tree-of-Heaven, is a plant species within the Simaroubaceae family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant properties. Research suggests that Red Chinese Tree-of-Heaven has therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
